text.p: Mondragon International Philippines Inc said on Monday its board had approved a 20 percent final stock dividend for 1996.
This is the second time in the year the company has declared a stock dividend. In the second quarter, it had a 50 percent stock dividend.

Mondragon also said its board approved an increase in authorised capital stock of the company to 1.0 billion pesos worth of shares from 600 million pesos. The new capital structure would have one billion shares with a par value of one peso each.
The 20 percent stock dividend is equivalent to 113.6 million pesos representing 113.6 million shares, the company said.
The record date of the dividend shall be determined after approval by the Philippine Stock Exchange and Securities and Exchange Commission, the company said.
